none: PAS FindID 996627: Lin-26AB67: Roman nummus of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper-alloy nummus of the house of Constantine, AD 335 - AD 337 (Reece period 17). Gloria Exercitus reverse. The coin is lightly worn with the focus of damage present around the exterior edges. Obverse: Clean-shaven, a youthful male, facing right, with a laureate crown with tails behind head. Inscription: 'CONSTANTI...' (only the begining of the inscription is legible. It is resemblant of constantine type, AD 335-337, number 99 (Reece & James, 1986, p.35). Reverse: Portrait of two soldiers holding single standard. Inscription: 'RI AEXER..ITU..'. The portrait is the same as Constantine type coins, AD 335 - AD 337, number 98 (Reece & James, 1986, p.35). Mint Mark: Not legible.…
